slides.title: Spoken Tutorial on Your First AI Application
slides.narration: Welcome to this Spoken Tutorial on **Your First AI Application**.

slides.title: Learning Objectives
slides.narration:
In this tutorial, you will learn to,

• Define what an **API** is.
• Explain how to obtain an **API key**.
• Apply the **Gemini API** to build a simple **AI application**.
• Identify the components of an **AI application** script.

slides.title: System Requirements
slides.narration: Here I am using a browser on a computer or mobile.

slides.title: Pre-requisites
slides.narration: To follow this tutorial, you should have completed Episode 1 and 2 of this Module.

slides.title: What is an AI Application?
slides.narration:
What is an **AI application**?
It uses **artificial intelligence** to perform specific tasks.
Think of it like a smart assistant.
It understands your requests and generates responses.
Imagine a chef creating a dish using ingredients and recipes.
An **AI application** works in a similar way.
slides.image_prompt: Illustration showing AI application as a smart assistant, like a chef creating a dish

slides.title: Understanding APIs
slides.narration:
Now, let's understand **APIs**.
An **API**, or **Application Programming Interface**, acts as a messenger.
It allows different software applications to communicate.
Imagine an **API** as a waiter in a restaurant.
The waiter takes your order, which is a request.
He brings it to the kitchen, which is the **AI model**.
Then, he brings back your food, which is the **AI's** response.
slides.image_prompt: Illustration showing API as a waiter taking an order to the kitchen (AI model) and bringing back food (AI's response)

slides.title: Getting Your API Key
slides.narration:
First, navigate to **Google AI Studio**.
Sign in with your **Google** account.
Then, **click** 'Get **API key**'.
This will create a new key.
I am copying this key.
slides.image_prompt: Browser showing Google AI Studio interface, highlighting 'Get API key' button

slides.title: Setting Up Google Colab
slides.narration:
Open a new **Google Colab** notebook.
Install the `google-generativeai` package.
Type `!pip install -q -U google-generativeai`.
Then, import this package.
slides.image_prompt: Screen close-up: user typing '!pip install -q -U google-generativeai' in Google Colab

slides.title: Configuring the API
slides.narration:
Configure the **API** with your copied **key**.
Replace `YOUR_API_KEY` in the code.
Use your actual **API key**.
Then, initialize the `gemini-pro` **model**.
slides.image_prompt: Screen close-up: user replacing 'YOUR_API_KEY' and initializing 'gemini-pro' model in Google Colab

slides.title: Crafting Your AI Prompt
slides.narration:
Now, let's craft your **AI prompt**.
Define your product topic.
For example, `product_topic = "a new brand of eco-friendly sneakers"`.
Then, create your **prompt**.
It could be `prompt = f"Create 5 catchy marketing slogans for {product_topic}"`.
slides.image_prompt: Screen close-up: user typing 'product_topic = "a new brand of eco-friendly sneakers"' and the prompt variable in Google Colab

slides.title: Generating and Printing Slogans
slides.narration:
Send your **prompt** to the **model**.
Use `response = model.generate_content(prompt)`.
Then, print the **AI's** response.
Type `print(response.text)`.
slides.image_prompt: Screen close-up: user typing 'response = model.generate_content(prompt)' and 'print(response.text)' in Google Colab

slides.title: Running Your Application
slides.narration:
Ensure your **API key** is correctly inserted.
**Press** the play button next to the code block.
This executes the script in **Colab**.
See the generated marketing slogans.
slides.image_prompt: Google Colab interface: user pressing play button, showing generated marketing slogans as output

slides.title: Summary
slides.narration:
Let us summarize what we learned.
We defined what an **API** is.
We learned how to get an **API key**.
Then, we built a simple **AI** marketing slogan creator.
We used **Python** and the **Gemini API** in **Google Colab**.

slides.title: Assignment
slides.narration:
Now as an assignment,
Modify the `product_topic` variable.
Generate slogans for a different product.
Compare the results.
